name: Collaterised Data 12
definition: Specifies the details of the collateralised securities.

CollateralValueDate.name: Collateral Value Date
CollateralValueDate.definition: Date on which the counterparties contractually agree the exchange of cash, securities, or commodities versus collateral for the opening leg (spot leg) of the securities financing transaction.

AssetType.name: Asset Type
AssetType.definition: Specification on the type of asset used as collateral.

NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.name: Net Exposure Collateralisation Indicator
NetExposureCollateralisationIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the collateral has been provided for a net exposure, rather than for a single transaction.

OneElementPresentRule.definition: At least one element must be present.
